review_context.scope: Frozen local E04 application backend, SDK and standalone declarations/build pipeline, local helper/template, owner configuration contracts/store/core/API/client integration. Read-only defensive source review; security-auditor adapted to source tracing only.

acceptance_observations.AC-53: Independent cell scope/migration/store UUID, server-owned paths and listener scope separate application users from owner identities. Single runtime is enforced using PostgreSQL advisory ownership plus health fencing, PGlite process lock, runtimeActive and filesystem instance lock/store binding.
acceptance_observations.AC-54: Better Auth transactional adapter, derived cell cookie/authority, bounded route/body/rate/session policy, strict signup inputs, explicit data-only configured OAuth providers/PKCE and callback origin/provider checks are present. Native session values are removed from public JSON.
acceptance_observations.AC-55: runtime.ts:126-127 captures epoch before body/lane waits; state.ts:148 inherits it through AsyncLocalStorage. Explicit stream epochs remain bound. Core metadata and lifecycle independently inspect raw preview deadlines; guard reads project/environment/configuration/epoch inside the existing control lock transaction.
acceptance_observations.AC-56: Quota reservations precede bytes; pending chunk offset/hash persists before I/O, retained partial prefixes are verified and resumed, full writes/reads loop and sync precedes metadata advancement. Completion verifies actual bytes; deletion tombstones before unlink and retains quota until cleanup settlement.
acceptance_observations.AC-57: Owner-scoped lookups, safe server identifiers, root/link/descriptor checks, grant/session/lifecycle revalidation and bounded downloads are present. Recovery schema/HMAC/scope/aggregate quotas and durable HOLD precede restored state; source time coverage and unknown external recovery gap are explicit.
acceptance_observations.AC-58: Only trusted runtime publishes events, with durable idempotency and recipient checks. SSE cursors bind cell/user and gaps request refetch; browsers have no arbitrary publication route.
acceptance_observations.AC-59: Pull-driven finite SSE/download resources include cancellation, lifetime, current-session/lifecycle checks and shutdown cleanup. Final download closure retains its promise; runtime snapshots and awaits closers before releasing ownership.
acceptance_observations.AC-60: Separate browser SDK validates version/DTOs/response bounds, binds scope and fixed paths, supports abort and observed-cursor reconnection. Convenience upload computes actual SHA-256 under a documented16MiB cap; larger streams use bounded low-level methods. Standalone declarations rewrite application-contract imports and the output manifest has no server dependency.
acceptance_observations.AC-61: Explicit standalone loopback template is distinct from controller-managed lifecycle authority; owner configuration remains metadata-only and runtimeConnected is literal false. File quota cannot exceed the declared environment disk budget. Typed custom POST uses supplied transaction for business mutation/session verification.
acceptance_observations.AC-62: Reviewed tests cover actual stores/HTTP/template process restart, local PKCE, recovery/files, faulted durable intents, epoch changes, SDK contracts and independently consumed built declarations. Execution and full regression outcomes remain the caller/GAUNTLET gate, not inferred from source.

resolved_findings.evidence: packages/core/src/backend-configuration.ts:32,184 checks raw expiry independently; applicationLifecycleGuard uses write(store) and matching current revisions.

packages/app-backend/src/file-read.ts reserves finite capacity, cleans setup failures and retains close promise through descriptor closure; runtime.ts:256-261 snapshots/awaits closers before closing store.
store.ts dedicated PG advisory session/healthy fence or local process lock; runtime.ts denies duplicate store factories and acquires file-root lock; private-files.ts marker binds store UUID.
Single runtime ownership prevents already-open duplicate stores; recovery.ts durably persists HOLD before import and store.ts reloads it on reopen.
io.ts loops short writes/reads; file-write.ts verifies and resumes retained partial chunk prefix then syncs and hashes before durable offset advancement.
recovery.ts:106,118,160 uses the shared RECOVERY_METADATA_BYTES limit for export and import; strict envelope/archive schemas bound and validate rows before copying.

state.ts now exposes explicit data-only ApplicationOAuthProvider validated by a strict schema; arbitrary function/discovery options are deliberately outside the documented supported contract, with no structuredClone failure.

packages/sdk/src/files.ts computes actual content SHA-256 before initiating, rejects supplied-hash mismatch and returns matching committed replay; different same-length content changes the initiation digest.
file-read.ts:134-146 retains the descriptor-close promise and removes registries after closure; runtime.ts:254-264 retains shutdown promise and snapshots closers before abort.
custom.ts final session id/user/expiry check uses handler transaction rather than the global PGlite connection, preserving transactional business mutation without deadlock.
